entry.author: Unitec
entry.summary:
Free Trades & Construction Tour 
TUESDAY 17 JUNE | 11AM | UNITEC’S MT ALBERT CAMPUS

Find out where a career in trades can take your future.

• We build real houses. Yes, students build homes from start to finish, onsite at Unitec.
• Tour Mataaho, one of the largest open-plan trades training centres in Aotearoa.
• From the classroom, workshop, job site and lab, see our hands-on approach to learning in real time.
• Talk with ākonga and kaiako. Hear from current students and lecturers about life in the trades.
• Find the answers to all your questions.
Spaces are limited. Register at the link in bio.

Bring covered shoes for workshop safety. Questions? Email, trades@unitec.ac.nz.

Bringing your teen along? You're welcome too — it's a relaxed, supervised visit with no pressure to enrol, just honest answers about their options.
#Unitec #Trades #Carpentry #Plumbing #Automotive #Apprenticeship #Auckland
